children: The global crypto economy barely contracted in the 12 months that ended in June despite a roughly 50% drop in crypto asset prices, according to a new report from Chainalysis. Economic activity in the crypto space measured at $9.4 trillion in the year that ended June 30, down just 1.6% from year prior, the report says. The growing diversity of crypto use cases helped to blunt the impact of falling prices, the analysts say. Cross-border stablecoin activity accelerated sharply, person-to-person transfers gained ground globally, and Latin America actually increased its crypto activity, the report says. (dean.seal@wsj.com)
